rows.label: qst630401_msg0001
rows.name: When will my father finally come home?

rows.label: qst630401_msg0002
rows.name:
I am sorry, but Bonavento is still on
a mission...

rows.label: qst630401_msg0003
rows.name:
The war is over, isn't it!? Please
tell me the truth!

rows.label: qst630401_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm afraid that information
is classified, and I am not
at liberty to discuss it.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0005
rows.name: That's enough!

rows.label: qst630401_msg0006
rows.name:
You're the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries,
right?

rows.label: qst630401_msg0007
rows.name:
Actually, there are mercenaries who
have not returned from their mission.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0008
rows.name:
There was a bit of trouble with
Superbia out in Temperantia, right?

rows.label: qst630401_msg0009
rows.name:
At the time, we assigned four skilled
mercenaries to keep watch on the
Superbian army.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0010
rows.name:
But war never broke out, and a
cease-fire was reached without much
trouble...

rows.label: qst630401_msg0011
rows.name:
They may not have seen the signal to
withdraw, but they never returned.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0012
rows.name:
We had no choice but to return without
searching for them.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0013
rows.name:
If the army moved and provoked
Superbia, fighting could break out
again...

rows.label: qst630401_msg0014
rows.name:
That's why I have a favor to ask,
given your skills.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0015
rows.name:
Could you find the four mercenaries...
Bonavento and the others, and bring
them back?

rows.label: qst630401_msg0016
rows.name: Thank you.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0017
rows.name:
As for Bonavento's group, we know they
spent the first day near Holy Grail
Hammer.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0018
rows.name:
But we do not know where they went
after that...

rows.label: qst630401_msg0019
rows.name:
Start at Holy Grail Hammer and look
for clues there.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0020
rows.name:
By the way, that woman earlier is
Bonavento's only daughter.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0021
rows.name:
I sent her away saying it was
classified, but I'm worried too.

rows.label: qst630401_msg0022
rows.name:
For her sake as well, I'm counting on
you.
